THIS GAME IS AMAZING! Honestly you're doing yourself a 10ish+ hour favor by playing it (if you want to feel like a hacker, solve some tricky puzzles, explore an intricate and interesting storyline that gives you as much freedom to explore as you want, and learn some stuff about computers along the way!) I finished the whole thing in two sessions within a 36 hour window because it was so addicting hehe. The puzzles are a good level of challenging, and do a good job of starting easy and getting harder as you learn more so you are always prepared for the next one. This was one of those games where I needed a piece of paper to keep track of IP addresses etc because there's a lot of jumping around using information from various places, but that's the fun of it :) Definitely going to play it through again.

Bought this game on a whim, not knowing anything about it. Holy shit did it rope me in.

As of right now, I have like 9+ hours and I haven't even finished the story entirely. It is massive amounts of fun, and I think I'll invest in the DLC just so I can continue the story. It makes you feel like a total badass when you get into a really complicated system and shut it down from the inside. 

A word of caution: If you feel stuck on a mission and don't know where to go; google it. You may run into an issue where you accidently delete a file or a log that you need for a mission. If you are mid mission, DO NOT HIT THE SAVE ICON. You may make a mistake and be stuck in a cycle of needing a certain IP but not being able to get it because you delete your logs. This can make your story progression (as far as I know) impossible.

If you have ever pretended to be a hacker as you navigate Microsoft Windows through it's Command Prompt, then you will thoroughly enjoy this game, and it is a very similar experience (graphic and playability wise). This game was a little difficult to start, and there were some parts that did not seem very intuitive as far as username hacking is concerned.  But overall, I really liked this game.  Has an original MS DOS feel to it with the HackNet interface that really got me into it.  Seemed quite immersive in that way.  The story is good also.  It was sad when I first noticed the "0".  

Pros: Good story.  Great interactivity.  100% dependence on player to advance story.  There are no question marks over the node you have to access next.  You have to discover where you have to go to get the information you need.  

Cons: Story can get a little disconnected at times.  All information provided does not always seem to point clearly to the answer needed to progress the next step (but this might just be my mind not putting A and B together correctly).

Would totally recommend if you are interested in trying an indie game that isn't simply a point and click or shoot-em-up.  It is an exercise of the mind.  Enjoy!

This game is absolutely fantastic. I remembered playing it many years ago, back when it was fresh from the competition that it stemmed from. I just finished playing that old copy and thought I'd see if there was a follow-up. Here it is... a continuation to that fantastic game. :D

Cons:
- Some spelling/grammar mistakes
- Some less-than-obvious paths forward at times
- Messy "targets" interface
- Would be nice if it were possible to find other x-server files to make use of expanded memory (instead of just one changes color)

Pros:
- Relatively easy to follow along with
- Not stupidly far off from how hacking actually works (difficulty on par with those code breaking sites)
- Fairly sensible story-line
- Nice progression
- It has an expansion that I need to check out... after seeing the completed game.

KIDS, DON'T DO THIS IN REAL LIFE! This glamorizes something that will have police knocking on your door before you even know what you did wrong. This game isn't at all real world "hacking" but is enough to get you in trouble! This is basically the GTA for script kiddies.

Having said that, as an adult I really enjoyed this as a chill game. I appreciated that there were linux commands and common ports that were correct to add to the realism. The story was nice, and poking around finding things (IRC chats were funny) with little challenges was enjoyable. [spoiler]Got a snicker out of hacking the clicker game. :) [/spoiler] The challenges were perfect in that there wasn't something completely obscure you shouldn't be able to solve yourself (as a "hacker," of course).

Having just finished the main story I'm happy to hear there's community support to keep this alive. Can't wait to explore what else is out there.
